BiblicalUsage: Perets-Uzza is the place where the LORD made a breach upon Uzzah, who touched the ark. David was displeased, and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the place keeps its warning: God is holy, and the breach at Perez-uzzah says so to every generation.
